name: CheckboxGroup
purpose: Lets users choose zero or more options from a small, visible set of independent choices.
neverUseFor: A single independent on/off choice — use Checkbox alone instead
Mutually exclusive choices — use RadioGroup instead
Large option sets or anything needing search — use a multi-select instead

authored.name: disabled
authored.description: The whole group, or an individual option, is non-interactive.

authored.name: required
authored.description: At least one value must be selected before form submission.

anatomy.description: Root element — groups the legend and options for assistive tech.
Accessible group label. Sits exactly 8px above the options — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md.
Layout wrapper for the option list. Each option renders a real `Checkbox`.
Helper text for the whole group. Sits exactly 8px below the options — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible group label, rendered as the fieldset's legend.

props.name: options
props.description: The list of choices. Each option: { value, label, description?, disabled? }.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Selection change handler — receives the full updated set of selected values.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction of the option list.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every option in the group.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the group as required (at least one selection).

props.name: name
props.description: Native checkbox name shared by every input, for form serialization. Auto-generated if omitted.

height.note: No size prop exists — each checkbox control is one fixed size (16px), inherited unchanged from Checkbox. Does not follow the ADR-004 field scale.

keyboardNav: Tab — moves focus between options and into/out of the group
